fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-07-10, the cousin of the complainant, Saravanan Palanisamy, aged 19, left for a temple visit and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Anbu Layout Bus Stand Area in Thanjavur. The time of the incident was given as 06:45 on 2025-07-10. The complaint was lodged by Sanjay Raj (9000000083), a family member of Saravanan Palanisamy, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000235. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Karthik Velan (9000000188), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. A witness, Praveen Natarajan, reachable on 9000000041, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, associate, witness, screenshot, early morning, bus stand
